subgoals.description: Research and compile a list of potential Edinburgh venues with key details such as name, location, capacity, price range, and amenities
subgoals.success_criterion: List of venues with all required details compiled and verified

subgoals.description: Select the most suitable venue based on common event criteria like capacity and location
subgoals.success_criterion: Single venue selected with justification for suitability

subgoals.description: Draft the flyer content using the selected venue's details and event information
subgoals.success_criterion: Complete flyer text including venue name, location, features, and event details
